==Summary==

{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

Egwene receives a strapping from the [[Mistress of Novices]], [[Silviana Brehon]]. Egwene thinks that her resolve to receive the illegitimate punishments has increased, yet she has not fully managed to embrace pain as the [[Aiel]] do. Egwene thinks, despite the situation she is in due to [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]], that Silviana is a good and dutiful Mistress of Novices. Silviana offers kind words and dismisses Egwene to dinner, but tells her to return later for further punishment. Egwene reveals eating will have to wait as she is to attend [[Elaida]] over dinner. Silviana expresses surprise at this and questions Egwene as to why she did not mention this beforehand. Egwene calmly asks would it have changed anything.

Egwene leaves the Mistresses of Novices study. Outside of the study she is given a dose of [[forkroot]] by [[Katerine Alruddin]] and [[Barasine]]. She lingers as she does not wish to arrive early at Elaida's quarters as that would imply deference, and moreover she is curious if [[Alviarin Freidhen]] will visit the Mistress of Novices to be punished. Egwene initiates a discussion with Katerine and Barasine about the declining harmony and unity of the [[The White Tower|Tower]] under Elaida's leadership. Egwene is rebutted by Katerine, whereas the silent Barasine shows worry. Unexpectedly Alviarin does not show up for punishment as she usually does at this time. As Egwene heads to Elaida's quarters, she notices a mural of an ancient [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]]; for a moment she sees death and destruction on it, a ripple of the [[Dark One]]'s work, and then it turns back to normal. As she continues on her way, she notices Alviarin heading toward her punishment session and wonders what caused her delay.

Egwene resolves to hold her tongue while serving at Elaida's table, deciding that refusing to engage her is the best way to oppose her in this situation. She walks into Elaida's room only to be shocked by the presence of [[Meidani]], one of her spies, being subservient to Elaida. Egwene knows she has to keep her emotions in check, but she is enraged time and time again as she is forced to hear Elaida recount how she has treated to the other sisters and hear her gloat about their reactions to the increasingly outrageous demands she has handed down. When Elaida begins discussing having Aes Sedai take a fourth oath, one of obedience to the Amyrlin, Egwene can stomach no more outrage and pours out the bowl from which she has been serving soup to the two Aes Sedai. Elaida is beside herself over the damage to her expensive rug and orders Meidani to assist Egwene in trying to clean it with towels and cold water while she hollers from the door for servants. Egwene instructs Meidani to call for her for instruction so they can discuss the current situation and after showing initial irritation, Medaini finally agrees. Egwene is then sent away with Elaida feeling confident about being in control of Egwene.

Egwene goes to the kitchens to eat before her visit with the Mistress of Novices. Egwene has a revelation: the Tower did not need her help to depose Elaida as Elaida would be toppled with or without Egwene, and instead she decides her duty is to keep the Tower and its occupants together.

Egwene arrives at the Mistress of Novices study where she finds Silviana reading [[Meditations on the Kindling Flame]]. She informs Silviana that Elaida had talked of revoking and changing the [[Three Oaths]]. Silviana administers a strapping to Egwene, and as the strapping progresses Egwene begins to laugh at the situation of the chaos and decline of the the Tower under Elaida. The two discuss Egwene's laughter. Silviana states that she cannot refuse to punish Egwene, which Egwene agrees with, and the strapping continues. Egwene realizes there is a lot of work to do.
